candidates.title: Extension Save As may acquire an unrelated Profile's last-active native parent
candidates.observation: The picker permits EXTENSION_API without associated WebContents. If owning_window is absent or lacks a host, it uses GetLastActiveBrowserWindowInterfaceWithAnyProfile()->GetWindow()->GetNativeWindow(). DownloadPrefs still comes from the DownloadItem BrowserContext.
candidates.inference: An extension request originating in Profile A may be parented to the last-active Profile B host. Source alone does not prove actual UI misrouting or data access across Profiles.
reproductionPrerequisites: Declared native RC and authorized extension fixture
Profile A owns the test extension/download
expectedEvidence: Actual owning dialog native handle and Profile context
DownloadItem BrowserContext and final target identity
candidates.recommendedAction: Coordinator forwards to downloads and window-chrome owners for native regression coverage and ownership review; no patch or new classifier in this packet.
